hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$d=(Get-Location).Path; while ($true) { $p=Join-Path $d '.claude\hooks\kb-guard.ps1'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { & $p; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $parent=Split-Path -Parent $d; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($parent) -or $parent -eq $d) { break }; $d=$parent }; throw 'kb-guard.ps1 not found above working directory'"
